method: food_total is the sum of itemized food estimates after pantry deduction.
non_food_total must include the non-food reserve.
total equals food_total plus non_food_total and must not exceed the event total_cap.
food_total must not exceed the event food_cap.
Report variance against the cap; never change the cap.
note: Method only. Event caps arrive in events/<event>/seed/finance/budget.json.
